notablePrerequisites: You control at least five untapped Myr.
description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it and five Myr, searching your library for Myr Battlesphere and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Reito Sentinel by paying {3}, putting Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat each turn.
